description: A young person with shaggy brown hair and a patterned shirt sits at a wooden desk typing on a beige plastic computer with a built-in keyboard. A small CRT monitor on top shows a simple green and pink blocky picture, and a cassette recorder sits beside the machine. The room behind is dark, with bookshelves and a framed picture in the top left corner. The style is a dark oil painting that fills the frame edge to edge.
